name: Damaru 3D Instrument Agent
description: Playable 3D Indian Damaru hourglass drum with XPBD braided striker cords, Bessel-mode circular membrane physics, and WebMCP control tools.

tools.name: get_damaru_state
tools.description: Inspect 3D Damaru orientation, angular velocity, cord tension, fundamental pitch (Hz), and strike counters.

tools.name: strike_damaru
tools.description: Tap left/right goatskin drumhead or wooden shell with velocity-matched physical modeling.

tools.name: shake_damaru
tools.description: Physically oscillate the 3D Damaru around its waist to whip both beaded cords across the drumheads.

tools.name: set_damaru_tension
tools.description: Cinch or release the V-laced waist cords to bend pitch up by up to +5.3 semitones.

tools.name: play_damaru_rhythm
tools.description: Perform a rhythmic bol sequence (Dam, Dha, Du, Ta, Na, Rim, Roll, .) at a target BPM.
